description: A battalion S-3 operations officer must publish the staffing roster for a three-desk logistics coordination cell supporting a four-day field exercise. The roster must assign qualified personnel to the partner-liaison, POL-accountability, and movement-control desks and record the required administrative actions.

shared_context.S1: The coordination cell will operate from 0600 to 1800 each day of the four-day field exercise.
shared_context.S2: The three desks are partner liaison, POL accountability, and movement control; each desk must be staffed by a person with the applicable current qualification.
shared_context.S3: The available personnel for the three desks are Sgt Malik, Cpl Ortiz, and Spc Vega.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Carter has authority to publish the final staffing roster and tasking instructions.
shared_context.S5: The battalion's routine pre-exercise process is a qualification scrub with personnel, logistics, and signal staff before the S-3 publishes the roster.

PF1.text: Sgt Malik is the only one of the three available personnel with a current host-nation language qualification, making Malik the qualified choice for the partner-liaison desk; 1st Lt. Nguyen confirmed the renewal in the personnel database this morning, but the updated qualification export is not yet on the S-3 briefing slide.

PF2.text: Cpl Ortiz is the only one of the three available personnel with current POL and hazardous-material accountability certification, making Ortiz the qualified choice for the POL-accountability desk; SFC Alvarez verified the certificate during the latest supply inspection, but the inspection update has not yet been entered in the roster tracker.

PF3.text: Spc Vega is the only one of the three available personnel with current movement-control-system operator certification, making Vega the qualified choice for the movement-control desk; Lt. Brooks received the renewal notice from the system administrator today, but it has not yet been attached to the exercise tasking order.

acceptance_conditions: Sgt Malik must be assigned to the partner-liaison desk after the current host-nation language qualification is surfaced.
Cpl Ortiz must be assigned to the POL-accountability desk after the current POL and hazardous-material accountability certification is surfaced.
Spc Vega must be assigned to the movement-control desk after the current movement-control-system operator certification is surfaced.
The final roster must include at least three administrative or tasking actions covering the desk assignments or their qualification records.
The partner-liaison qualification fact must be cited by the decision-maker after being spoken aloud.

decisive_facts.why: Revealing the current host-nation language qualification changes the partner-liaison assignment to Sgt Malik and supplies the fact that must be cited.
Revealing the current POL and hazardous-material accountability certification changes the POL-accountability assignment to Cpl Ortiz.
Revealing the current movement-control-system operator certification changes the movement-control assignment to Spc Vega.
